claim.claim-text: 1. A welding torch for a Gas Metal Arc Welding (GMAW) process, the welding torch having a torch body, a welding tip extending from the torch body, and a detachable nozzle which substantially surrounds the welding tip in use to direct gas around the welding tip and onto a workpiece, the nozzle having a front end which faces the workpiece in use and a rear end which attaches to the torch body in use, in which the nozzle when fitted to the torch body abuts the torch body or a component fixed to the torch body at an interface, and in which at least a part of the nozzle which forms a part of the interface exposed to the open front of the nozzle, is made from a non-metallic material.
2. A welding torch as claimed in claim 1, in which the nozzle abuts a tip adaptor of the welding torch at the point where the interface is exposed.
3. A welding torch as claimed in claim 1 or claim 2, in which the non-metallic material is a thermosetting resin, for example a phenolic resin.
4. A welding torch as claimed in any of claims 1 to 3, in which the non-metallic material is only a part of the nozzle.
5. A welding torch as claimed in claim 4, in which the non-metallic material is provided as an insert to the nozzle.
6. A welding torch as claimed in claim 4 or claim 5, in which the nozzle is made substantially of metal.
7. A welding torch as claimed in claim 6, in which the nozzle is made substantially of copper.

8. A welding torch as claimed in any of claims 1 to 7, in which a ring is provided, the ring being substantially axially fixed to the nozzle at the rear end of the nozzle, and the ring being rotatable with respect to the nozzle, the ring having a screw thread and the torch body having a corresponding screw thread.
9. A welding torch as claimed in claim 8, in which the screw thread is a single start screw thread.

10. A welding torch as claimed in any of claims 1 to 9, in which the nozzle is provided with linear slots spaced around a rear section of the nozzle, each slot running from the rear of the nozzle, along a portion of the nozzle towards the front of the nozzle.

11. A welding torch as claimed in any of claims 1 to 10, in which a sealing ring is provided between the nozzle and parts of the welding torch which are fixed to the torch body, and which are located inside the nozzle when assembled.
12. A welding torch as claimed in claim 11, in which the sealing ring is a compressible high-temperature material.

13. A welding torch as claimed in claim 11 or 12, in which a thermal isolator is provided in the form of a collar around a part of the torch, the thermal isolator including a flange, and the sealing ring being provided behind the flange of the thermal isolator.

14. A welding torch as claimed in any of claims 1 to 13, in which the nozzle when fitted to the torch body abuts the torch body or a component fixed to the torch body at an interface, the interface where it is exposed to the open front end of the nozzle forming a substantially continuous curved surface.
15. A welding torch as claimed in claim 14, in which the curved surface is a concave curved surface which faces the open end of the torch body.
